scope: 03 only. Direct-contact conditional replicas of an inventory-matched seven-site cavity, not R4 InfoNCE, bulk simulation, phase or correlation length. anchors: 216 disjoint candidate stars: periodic random shift of (3z,3y,3x), z,y,x=0..5, L20. For each immutable parent use PCG64 [309031,b,seed,id] to choose a shift and a random ordering of candidate indices before opening species. First candidate of observed inventory (vac,A,B)=(2,2,3) in that ordering; uniform among eligible windows of that parent. Equal weight to each contributing parent; all eligible counts and misses saved. Candidate stars do not intersect, so replacing the selected interior within the sector cannot change its selection probability. Never replace a different inventory. Canonical state order lexicographic 0/1/2 in [center,-z,+z,-y,+y,-x,+x].
benchmark: Enumerate 210 states on each exterior; retain exterior types on the 18 adjacent sites, fixed exterior neighbor occupation counts there and in the seven-site star, integer relative energies, native/roster rows, observed state and anchor. Integer full-L20 energy-difference checks on all states of representative periodic stars; cubic permutation equivariance, beta-zero uniformity and spectral null. No 210x210 per-parent objects. One p row per exterior in float64 from min-shifted Boltzmann weights.
spectrum: TRAIN centered law C=Cov_B(pB), S=diag(pbar)-pbar pbar^T. Solve generalized eigenproblem in supported state-indicator span (mean TRAIN mass >=1e-10; discard marginal covariance eigenvalues <=1e-12 times largest or <=1e-14). Constant removed. Fit eigenvectors only on TRAIN, orient largest absolute coefficient positive; apply unchanged to TEST. Train mean/variance normalization; at beta=0 ratios of zero memory are undefined. Report spectrum, near gaps <=.01 absolute, extremes with marginal weights/observed frequencies, TRAIN split-half spectra and sensitivity excluding marginal mass <1e-3 or exterior-weight ESS<100. Report participation and marginal mass carrying half the squared standardized amplitude, not just rare-state maxima.
ordinary: TRAIN-selected best of 7 single-site vacancy indicators; separately best central single species indicator; coordination/energy candidates: center neighbor count, center's occupied coordination penalty, number of like/occupied opposite arm pairs, and occupied opposite-arm count. Best individual from these groups and best linear span of all 7x(A,B) indicators. Shared exterior measure; paired TEST oracle-minus-ordinary, learned-minus-linear and fraction comparisons. An unrestricted signed 210-state contrast is not a four-label InfoNCE ceiling.
training: First complete all-ten exact physical reference and save it. Then 30 independent stock models: beta separately, paired seeds 6101/6102/6103. Per eligible TRAIN exterior, 16 IID ordered pairs of independent conditional categorical draws, PCG64 [309032,b,chain_seed,chain_id], same bank for all starts. Equality of independent draws is allowed; never copy one draw to both views. Dense star in 3x3x3, A/B indicators only, other sites zero constants. V is first and E second replica; no energy, boundary IDs, species outside, mode labels or beta. Stock Adam .009/batch 500 including final remainder, original shuffle=100000, critic + relaxed logits model. epochs=ceil(10000/ceil(16*Ntrain/500)); actual checkpoints 850,1700,3400,6800,final >=10000. No retries of numerically failed starts, no TEST-led model/depth selection. Negative columns may come from same parent (15/(16*Ntrain-1) for uniformly mixed slots; finite shuffle buffer noted).
readout: Primary deterministic pre-noise sign of each of two logits (>=0), four labels. Secondary independent thresholded stochastic bits, conditional activation sigmoid(logit) on each site (threshold of relaxed draw .5, independent logistic noises); save Q(h|x), logits and analytic relaxed means and second moments by quadrature at checkpoint temperature. Use Q(h|x) in pB Q, optimize centered four-state contrast a on TRAIN only. Exact TEST between-boundary variance / total output variance (including conditional noise) for frozen a. Emit entropy, support and collapse. Zero variance = undefined, not zero evidence. No critic score needed for primary; preserve critic tensors and raw stock training trace, no new InfoNCE claim.
inference: One star per eligible independent parent. Pointwise paired cluster delta-method t95 across TEST parents for absolute T, increment and ratio to frozen TRAIN oracle including its uncertainty. Fractions only if oracle lower CI >1e-4; no hard cap at 100%. At beta=0 physical T exactly zero for all nonconstant f. Useful cold learning (beta=3.05) requires all 3 finite final fits with noncollapsed hard code, T lower CI >0.05 and fraction lower CI >0.5. This is reconstruction, not novelty. Increment beyond simple packing requires each lower CI(learned-linear)>0.01; residual observed attainable memory requires lower CI(oracle-linear)>0.01. Report all starts/depths and whether cold oracle contrast is localized (flag if <=1% marginal mass accounts for half squared amplitude). No task 04 or kinetic runs.
